limits: Formation cohorts are suspicious candidates, never automatic errors.
An episode can contain overlapping different cohorts; only peak.actors were measured together in that peak window.
Restarts excluded. Pairs alone and goalkeepers are not judged as tabletop groups.
Attacking support, opponent reactions and rationale need context review; no game role labels are treated as truth.
